name: Billy Kelleher - § 6/4
title: REPORT on gender inequalities in health, specifically as regards gender-specific conditions
part_text: ‘emphasises the importance of science-based, efficient and innovation-friendly health policies that take into account biological and social differences between women and men and that address the disparities therein; reiterates that research and innovation models in the health sector should drive developments that are in the interest of citizens;’ without the words ‘and social’
